name: com.shanflyer.burstword
description: High-throughput damage text using TMP resources, GPU animation and BRG with automatic GPU instancing fallback. Includes cross-platform shaping, an AnimationClip editor and ready-made benchmark scenes.

samples.description: Ready-made BRG and pooled TMP scenes (200 emissions/sec), multilingual fonts and four AnimationClip presets. Requires TMP Essential Resources.
